note: Privately operated marina resort on the south side of Harlan County Lake (USACE reservoir). The RV campground is the gravel loop north of the marina, around the shower house; the rest of the grounds are mobile-home lots, cabins and a tent area (Tent City). Sites are let nightly and as season-long annual sites (March 1 - November 15). Full-service marina (gas, bait, rentals) and a beach bar. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read today: ~80 campsites (30/50 A, water, dump), shower house, all nightly camping FCFS with a 2-week limit, $47/$52 tax included, annual sites Mar 1 - Nov 15. Hookups, sites, facilities, booking and fees now manual. Old note's $40/$45 prices removed. Gate passes ($47 incl. tax). Presence: website + phone, Google 4.6/130. Pin is on the mobile-home circle: re-pin ~330 m to the RV loop. Lakeview confirmed.
flags: PIN MOVE: stored 40.04114,-99.22910 is on the Snob Hill Rd circle, which the operator's map shows as mobile home lots (301-316). The RV campsite loop (sites 1-75, shower house) is ~330 m NW. Suggested 40.0435,-99.2315 (loop centre on NAIP, matched to the operator map).

WATER (lakeview confirmed): the west row (sites 70-75, 1-3) faces the lake across Camp Road, and the north end runs toward the shore past the road and a small inlet. That is a road between pad and water, so it is a view, not on-water.

LONG-STAY (passes as I read it, worth a look): 'Approximately 80 campsites are available for short-term and annual rental', with annual sites 'March 1st through November 15th', plus a separate mobile-home lot area (~70 lots on the map). The share of the 80 held as annual sites is not published. Nightly camping has a posted rate (test 2 passes) and a 2-week limit, and Google's 130 reviews read as transient campers.

BOOKING TEXT CONFLICT: the camping page says 'All camping is first come, first serve' but also shows 'Ready to go? Make your campsite reservations here' with no working link; the disclaimer mentions 'our many online reservation portals'. FCFS is the explicit statement and was written.
RATINGS: Google 4.6 from 130; RV Life 8 from 1 rating ($ tier). Good Sam directory: listed, not a Good Sam Park (good_sam false kept).

OWNERSHIP: 'private' kept. Harlan County Lake is a USACE reservoir and a marina resort on its shore is likely a Corps concession lease, but none of the operator's pages say so. If AWH classes Corps concessions as federal, this one needs checking.
PHONE (308) 799-4600 and website https://pattersonharbor.com/ confirmed (camping page: https://pattersonharbor.com/Rates-Rentals/Camping).
